capabilities: copy deep links to selected canvas groups via context menu or command palette
jump directly to the linked group when a link is clicked
open linked canvases in the current tab or a new tab
assign a hotkey to the copy-link command
warn when no group is selected or a group name is duplicated
intentEvidence: create links to specific groups within Canvases and jump to them in 1 click
problem: Canvas links open the whole canvas file but cannot target a specific group inside it, so users must scroll to find the right area.

relations.evidence: Based on the Obsidian Sample Plugin template

summary: Canvas group linking tool that copies deep links to canvas groups and jumps directly to the linked group when clicked.
